title: TICKET transition
description: The full post-state of one row turned into a TICKET, one entry of POST /projects/api/work/transition (keyed by the row's id, with "archetype": "TICKET" beside these). An absent property is CLEARED, and an absent membership means a root.

impetus.description: Why a ticket came about, in the reporter's words; usually one sentence.

assignee.description: Who is looking at it; free text.

acceptanceCriteria.description: What the work is accepted against, in order: short Markdown statements. The whole list is written at once; an empty list (or null on a patch) clears it. Frozen from READY_FOR_DEV on: restating the same list passes, a changed one is a 409.

items.description: Each item is one line of Markdown: not blank, no line break, at most one '.', and fewer than 20 whitespace characters.

supersededBy.description: The id of the item a DROPPED entity names as what answers for it: the duplicate it repeats, the item whose change resolved it, or the successor that replaced it. Required with outcome DUPLICATE, RESOLVED_ELSEWHERE or SUPERSEDED, refused with the other three; an item of the same project, never the entity itself.

outcome.description: Why a DROPPED entity was closed: DUPLICATE, RESOLVED_ELSEWHERE or SUPERSEDED (naming the item in supersededBy), OBSOLETE, INVALID or WONT_DO (naming none). Stated with status DROPPED alone, which requires one — except on a row already DROPPED with none, from before outcomes were recorded.

membership.description: Where the row hangs. A TICKET is a root, so this may be left out.

parent.description: A TICKET is a root: it has no parent.

position.description: Zero-based place among the parent's children; absent appends it last.
